display_name: F跨RX50弱发射机：分组特征尾部风险与均值对照
description: Original F+CROSS_RX50 scratch33L+17U retained. Paired current-L shallow/middle contrastive risk: sameTX/differentRX positives and differentTX/sameRX negatives, equal weakTX and RX. Compare mean versus upper-half after averaging the two original RDrop per-anchor losses. No new model forward, parameters, IQ reads, optimizer step or auxiliary head. No satellite; clean only.
authorization: Active user worse-transmitter feature-learning goal; local, no satellite augmentation/test, default head joint. Source feature geometry motivates a generic all-class margin, no target class-specific rule.

code.environment: Verified native Windows base Python3.10/PyTorch2.10+cu128; direct base interpreter; FP32/noTF32

data.representation: Original native received residual/post_sync/noeq, center crop/RMS normalized256 IQ; SAME validated mmap cache; native eq_i/sig_i/base_index restored by opaque physicalID join

roles.L_s: 6300 original visible source labels, randomL128 drop_last; ordinary augmentation; original native two RDrop forwards
roles.U_s: 56700 TX hidden; original U256 and batch_neighbor/ownEMA recipe during17U epochs; no new U feature objective
roles.V: 27000 no_grad defaulthead health plus descriptive actual joint160 source geometry. No V gradient/statistic in training, head fit, prototype classification, or target use.

data.split_id: original registered source/target physical split; reuse unchanged

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen default-head ManySig clean target168000 accuracy/MacroF1/perTX/RX/day; exposed benchmark; no independent blind/Phase2/satellite claim

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Existing source READY/EXACT_MATCH manifest reused; original role cache and native temporal metadata, current same-run initialization/source_frozen/native checkpoint args
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Scratch only, own scratch EMA. Reuse matching local BASE scores/source and prior sourceV geometry as references, never as initialized model state. Real BASE checkpoint only for one discarded noquery smoke.

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU0 max3 total source/predict workers across owners, freeRAM>=4.5GiB; CPU score max1 across this/current original50 run via CIM; preserve all healthy tasks
execution.stop_rule: Role/provenance/config/output conflicts, nonfinite loss/gradient, incomplete native budget/EMA/Sinc/feature scope or failed worker stop new dispatch; preserve outputs and other healthy workers; no automatic or performance-based retries

actual paired feature calls, eligibility, RXcell coverage, selected/available anchor objectives and selection fractions
source each-weak outRX cosine-margin q10 and RXspread/interTXgap; descriptive only

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent CPU truth-last only after row clean predictions fixed

notes: Original F CROSS_RX50=33L+17U/11100updates, RDrop1/ordinaryAug/LS.01/oldgate-ownEMA-cos/unified physical Sinc/defaultheadjoint. No satellite; clean168000 only. Local GPU0 max3 total GPU workers counting other owners/RAM>=4.5GiB; one CPU scorer; preserve all healthy tasks.

Current actual L128 only. Preserve original shallow/middle SupCon and original two stochastic RDrop forwards on the same actual augmented IQ. Added conditional contrastive risk uses sameTX/differentRX positives and otherTX/sameRX negatives. Mean/std descriptors use the exact base standardization and L2 normalization. No new joint160 branch, input/feature erasure, virtual update, projected head or parameters.

At each of two levels, compute each physical anchor loss in each existing RDrop view and average before mining. Fixed weakTX1/3 classes each get equal risk, and each observed RX cell within a weakTX gets equal risk. MEAN keeps all valid anchors; TAIL uses loss-largest ceil(n/2). Scores detached only for selection; selected feature losses retain real gradients to deployed Sinc/shallow/middle. Strong samples still serve as valid negative identities.

Max auxiliary coefficient.1, warm5/ramp10, exactly9990 scheduled calls from1111to11100. Both modes share all pairs/normalization/coverage/call schedule and source roles. Default head remains normal mainjoint, with no direct added-loss gradient. Zero extra model forwards, new IQ reads, realoptimizer steps or inference cost.

Source-only fixed promotion: each weakTX outRX cosine-margin q10>=same-seed BASE+.002, RXspread/interTXgap<=1.05x, zero features0; defaulthead overall>=-.2pp,worstRX>=-.5pp,anyTX>=-1pp.9990 scheduled, eligible>=99%, across-level weakTX/RX cell coverage>=95%. Missing cells are averaged among observed cells, recorded and evaluated scientifically, not a technical reason to skip legal initial clean.

Reference source geometry reuses existing27000 sourceV/3fixed localBASE diagnostic. All sourceRX were seen by encoder; outRX excludes RX only from descriptive centroids, not model training. Final existing no_grad V pass collects rawjoint160 and defaulthead outcomes; no fitted head/prototype decisions/V gradient. Fixed weakTX set and source criteria are unchanged from before the new target access.

Initial seed01 two arms both finish source before new candidate target. Each arm expands unchanged02/03 only by fixed source rule. Scientific fail still auto-clean-tests initial rows. Matched BASE source/predictions reused, no duplicate control training, no target-derived hyperparameter scan/reseed/checkpoint choice. All negatives retained.

Motivation is source feature-tail weakness and failure of extra default-head CE/metaCE to improve both weak source margins. Prior mean joint160 and angular margin paths differ in layer, reduction and pair objective. References: supervised contrastive https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.11362 and hard mining https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content_cvpr_2016/html/Shrivastava_Training_Region-Based_Object_CVPR_2016_paper.html . This is a controlled RF/source adaptation, not an invented/general effectiveness claim or canonical paper reproduction.

Checks PASS:10 protocol/config negatives, hand-derived group mean/tail values+gradients, pairing-before-selection integration, legal masks and finite no-pair gradients, actual F CPU andCUDA combined backward with Sinc/shallow/middle nonzero and defaultW auxiliaryNone/mainW normal, original initialization/warmup/EMA/export unchanged, exactly2 real time_down forwards, main CPU/CUDA RNG unchanged, one matching realcheckpoint noquery smoke discarded. Zero source/target IQ reads or realoptimizer/head updates in checks. One independent P0/P1 review PASS.

Backend FULL_FP32_NO_TF32/cudnn_deterministic=false retained. Same recipe does not claim bitwise crossprocess equality; actual n/sampleSD and n1 limits reported. Benchmark exposed: no new blind/Phase2/satellite claim.

REJECTED_EXTRA_GATE: design-approval pause and blanket whole-project suite suggested by generic skills are outside exclusive CVS whitelist. Existing user goal authorizes this bounded experiment; focused negative tests/realCP smoke and one independent P0/P1 review apply.
